correctness.rationale: By orthogonal invariance take J=[I_r 0] and S=[G;B]. Coefficient minimum gives B G†c; conditional variance ||G†c||² with reciprocal chi-square_{ell-r+1} by Gaussian Schur complement, independent chi-square_{d-r} numerator. Haar random ell-plane=ker H; physical minimum solves H2y=-H1c, giving independent chi-square_{d-ell}/chi-square_{ell-r+1} marginal, or exactly zero at ell=d. Beta-prime/Gamma integration gives each moment for 0<q<ell-r+1, divergence at/above cutoff and sharp t^{-nu} tails. Checks included Gaussian feasibility and minimum-norm inequality; (d,r,ell)=(2,1,2) deterministic S example confirms coefficient can inflate despite full span. The two marginal laws are NOT a joint law.
